# WorthPlaying — beta preview

- Original source: [PC Preview - Robin Hood: Legend Of Sherwood](https://www.worthplaying.com/article/2002/11/1/previews/6630-pc-preview-robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood/)
- Author / publication: Patrick; WorthPlaying.
- Language / date: English; 2002-11-01.
- Access: Substantial indexed preview text, including concluding assessment, inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Patrick’s preview emphasizes multiple solutions, team composition, distractions, and expressive reactions from guards and civilians. It praises the detailed scenery, music, and voice acting, and describes training and production at the forest headquarters.

The writer dislikes waiting until a mission ends for supplies and finds some mission types repetitive. An intermittent loss of control during combat is explicitly reported from a beta and should not be generalized to retail releases. This is distinct from WorthPlaying’s December review and documents impressions before the finished game reached players.
